description: This PHP class 'AdminPluginConfiguration' implements the 'PluginConfigurationInterface' and sets up dependency injection for various services in the OrangeHRM platform during plugin initialization, specifically registering services such as CountryService, UserService, PayGradeService, etc.

classes.name: AdminPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the admin plugin by registering essential services during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Method that registers various service classes with the container during plugin initialization.
